table.name: atom
table.purpose: One row per atom in a collection of molecules (TR### identifiers). Each atom belongs to a molecule and has an element symbol. Atoms are connected via the 'connected' table and bonds via the 'bond' table.

col_001.name: atom_id
col_001.description: Primary key. Unique atom identifier, formed as <molecule_id>_<atom_index>, e.g. TR031_31 is atom 31 of molecule TR031. Referenced by the 'connected' table (both endpoint columns), which links atoms to each other.

col_002.name: molecule_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to molecule.col_001. The molecule (TR###) this atom belongs to; the numeric suffix of col_001 matches this value.

col_003.name: element
col_003.description: Chemical element symbol of the atom, lowercase (h, c, o, n, cl, br, p, si, zn, ...). 21 distinct elements across the dataset.

table.name: bond
table.purpose: Chemical bonds between atoms within molecules; each row is one bond, identified by its molecule and the two atom indices it connects, with a bond-order symbol (single/double/triple).

col_001.name: bond_id
col_001.description: Primary key. Composite code: molecule ID (e.g. TR031) plus the two atom indices joined by the bond (e.g. _18_36), matching the pattern of the sample rows and the referenced_by join from connected.col_003.

col_002.name: molecule_id
col_002.description: Identifier of the molecule containing the bond; references molecule.col_001 (many bonds per molecule, 444 distinct molecules).

col_003.name: bond_order
col_003.description: Bond order in chemical notation: '-' single bond (10528), '=' double bond (1844), '#' triple bond (6).

table.name: connected
table.purpose: Incidence/junction table linking two atoms to the bond that connects them, within a molecule (TRxxx). Each row states that atom A and atom B of the same molecule are joined by a given bond. The composite (col_001, col_002, col_003) is effectively unique per row; the table appears to be a denormalized atom-pair-to-bond mapping (each bond listed twice, once per direction).

col_001.name: atom_a_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the first atom in the connected pair. Format TRmmm_n: molecule TRmmm, atom n. References atom.col_001 (many-to-one).

col_002.name: atom_b_id
col_002.description: Identifier of the second atom in the connected pair, same TRmmm_n format. References atom.col_001 (many-to-one).

col_003.name: bond_id
col_003.description: Identifier of the bond connecting the two atoms. Format TRmmm_a_b: bond between atoms a and b of molecule TRmmm, matching col_001/col_002. References bond.col_001 (many-to-one).

table.name: molecule
table.purpose: One row per molecule (identified by a TRxxx code). Atoms and bonds in the atom/bond tables link back to this table. The second column is a binary sign/charge flag whose exact meaning is unresolved.

col_001.name: molecule_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique molecule identifier of the form TRxxx (e.g. TR000, TR477). Referenced by atom.col_002 and bond.col_002, so each atom and bond row belongs to one molecule.
